lessons.title: Daily Routine

items.exampleMeaning: I have a break at eleven.

lessons.tip: In Italian, nouns have gender. 'Il' is used for masculine nouns, like 'il lavoro', while 'la' is for feminine nouns, like 'la pausa'. Remember this when using articles.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: A che ora inizia il lavoro?
dialogue.meaning: What time does the work start?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Do you have a break today?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sì, ho una pausa alle undici.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I have a break at eleven.

scenario.partnerRole: Your partner is a colleague who wants to talk about work.
scenario.brief: Ask questions about the work schedule and office details. Respond to your colleague's questions.
scenario.goal: You need to understand the daily routine at work.

lessons.title: Meetings

items.exampleMeaning: We need to discuss the project.

items.example: Ho il documento per la riunione.
items.exampleMeaning: I have the document for the meeting.
I want to participate in the meeting.
What is the agenda of the meeting?

lessons.tip: When talking about meetings, use 'la' for feminine nouns like 'la riunione' and 'l'agenda'. This helps you use the right articles.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: A che ora è la riunione?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hai il documento per la riunione?
dialogue.meaning: Do you have the document for the meeting?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Do you want to participate in the meeting?

scenario.partnerRole: Your partner is a team leader preparing for a meeting.
scenario.brief: Ask about the meeting time and documents. Discuss your participation.
scenario.goal: You need to confirm your role in the meeting.

lessons.title: Daily Tasks

items.exampleMeaning: I have a task to do.
I need to organize the work.
We need to communicate with the client.
I am waiting for the client's response.

lessons.tip: Remember that 'il' is used for masculine nouns like 'il compito' and 'il cliente'. Use 'la' for feminine nouns like 'la scadenza' and 'la risposta'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Qual è il compito di oggi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I have a task to do.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Do we need to communicate with the client?

scenario.partnerRole: Your partner is a project manager assigning tasks.
scenario.brief: Discuss daily tasks and deadlines with your partner.
scenario.goal: You need to understand your tasks and deadlines.

lessons.title: Work Schedule

items.example: Il mio turno è di mattina.
items.exampleMeaning: My shift is in the morning.

items.example: A che ora finisce il lavoro?

items.exampleMeaning: I have a day off on Saturday.

lessons.tip: Use 'il' for masculine nouns like 'il turno' and 'il giorno'. Use 'la' for feminine nouns like 'la settimana' and 'l'ora'. This will help you form correct sentences.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: L'orario di lavoro è dalle nove alle cinque.
dialogue.meaning: The work schedule is from nine to five.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: A che ora inizia il turno?
dialogue.meaning: What time does the shift start?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Quando è il tuo giorno libero?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Il mio giorno libero è sabato.

scenario.partnerRole: Your partner is a supervisor discussing schedules.
scenario.brief: Ask about the work schedule and shifts. Discuss your days off.
scenario.goal: You need to clarify your work schedule.
